headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results now on record
summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026. The filing completes the statutory compliance process following the shareholder meeting. For retail investors, such routine procedural filings have no immediate financial impact on share prices.
why_it_matters: No direct financial impact for retail shareholders.

headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn revises its 45th AGM outcome
hook: Typographical error prompts revised AGM outcome
summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn has issued a revised outcome for its 45th Annual General Meeting to correct a typographical error in the initial filing. The correction involves standard corporate disclosures made to the stock exchanges. Retail investors tracking routine procedural filings can note the update. No major operational or financial impacts are disclosed in this correction.
why_it_matters: Routine administrative correction with no impact on share price

headline: Gujarat Themis Biosyn amends Memorandum and Articles of Association
summary: Gujarat Themis Biosyn Limited has formally notified the stock exchange about amendments made to its Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA). The company has not yet detailed the specific clauses or reasons behind these legal framework updates in this initial filing. Such charter changes typically pertain to business object expansions, authorized capital adjustments, or updated regulatory compliances. For retail shareholders, procedural amendments of this nature carry negligible immediate impact on stock price or business operations.
why_it_matters: No direct financial or operational impact for retail holders.
